nom: COSRX The Niacinamide 15 Serum with Acetyl Glucosamine + Zinc PCA

avis.titre: My face has never been so bright!
avis.texte: This stuff really does work. I am noticing dark spots are lighter in my face looks so much brighter and more even overall. I will keep purchasing this for sure. I am currently on my second bottle.

I don't know what black magic is in this bottle but it is IT. This serum in combination with Sofie Pavitt Mandelic Clearing serum and Dieux's Baptism cleanser has kept my hormonal acne at bay. I am on my 3rd bottle and counting. Will be repurchasing til the end of time.
This product was an absolute game changer for me. I've struggled with oily skin forever and this helps my makeup stay in place all day!

I have been struggling with painful cystic acne for the past 5 years and finding the right products for my sensitive skin. I decided after a lot of research to revamp my entire beauty regim and WOW my skin is now clear and the scars are fading quickly. I use this serum 2x a day and I am quite pleased so far. I combine this with a good cleanser, retionoid serum, hydrochloric acid, lightweight moisturizer (and sunscreen during the day).
I am seeing great results and oil reduction. I have been using this after hyaluronic acid and before my moisturizer during the day under foundation and and very happy with the results

avis.titre: Completely Changed my Skin in 1 Month
avis.texte: I use this every evening before bed and before moisturizer. My skin is glowing and plump and bright. It looks so much better than a month ago. My pores are tighter and I also never get acne now.

I bought this to reduce my redness. My skin is prone to subclinical rosacea, so I don't have the traditional flare ups you think of with the condition, I just have a condtant baseline of redness all over with the occasional increase in redness due to heat/cold. This product did nothing for my redness. Not even after weeks of consistent use. I also did not see any reduction in acne inflammation and redness. So I can't recommend this product. Especially for the price. In addition, the product is sticky for a long while as it soaks in, and it did cause breakouts if I applied too much of it. 3-4 drops is enough for my face. It does play well with other products though.

Used this before bed last night and woke up to a matte face! I'm in my 40s and there hasn't been a day since puberty that I didnt wake up looking like an oil slick… until now! Hoping it helps my sebaceous hyperplasia too! That's what another review mentioned, which was why I bought it. 🤞🏼Excessively oily girlies - this is your solution!
Great product for matire skin. The packaging needs improvement. The suction doesnt get any product out so i have to pour directly from the bottle.

I've had smile lines on my left side that just stayed constantly creased for about the past 1.5 years—but now after using my first full bottle of this, they're almost totally gone! I've also been dealing with what seems to be perioral dermatitis (red blotchiness & occasional bumpy breakouts on smile lines & under nose; still in the process of figuring this out with my dermatologist)—& this is almost entirely gone too! I've tried so many different products, including prescriptions, and this is the first thing that has actually done the trick for both issues. Both issues do seem to resurface slightly if stop using this one for a few days, but never look as severe as before.

The serum itself is nice, didnt irritate my skin (i have sensitive skin). But the packaging is horrible. First, its quite small for what we pay for. Second, the suction tube doesn't take up much or release enough of the serum. There's a bit thats stuck, no matter how many times i try to squeeze it out, its still there. You have to squeeze at least twice to get a good amount for face and neck. The packaging is the only reason I wouldn't buy again. I hope they upgrade.

i do enjoy this product. It has a really nice lumious finish once applied and makes my skin look lush once my routine is done. I havent used it long enough to see my pores get to where i want them but it seems like its helping my nose pores stay less congested!

avis.titre: Love this and can't be without!
avis.texte: I am 76 years young and about a year ago, my skin suddenly developed milia on my upper lip and chin. I was using a sonic facial brush, PTR 2% salicylic acid pads and LaRoche Posay 2% sallicylic acid face cleanser! No matter what I did, those little white bumps showed up every day, driving me to express them before washing my face. When I saw this product, I thought "maybe?" Well, it is indeed a miracle worker! No more milia, pores looking smaller on my nose - just rosy, healthy skin. I never had shiny, oily skin - just very over-productive oil glands in certain areas. This is great because it lessens any red marks (I also have Rosacea) and doesn't dry out the non-problem areas of my face. I absolutely recommend - regardless of your age!

I was really happy with this product at first. It does what it claims it will do. But with every day use I noticed my pores were getting more and more clogged. I was getting blackheads and breakouts, and my sebaceous filaments were getting larger. As soon as I stopped using this my skin smoothed out again. I definitely would not recommend this for every day use. I will keep this to use for special events only.

I have skin discoloration/blemishes on my face from healed contact dermatitis breakouts and I've tried toners, exfoliation, steroid cream and other niacinamide products. I've used the COSRX Niacinamide 15 serum for a few days 2x/day and have already seen a significant improvement in the blemishes ! Have a feeling they'll be completely gone within a month. Amazing.

avis.titre: Magic rednesss/acne/pore eraser for my fair skin!
avis.texte: I am in LOVE with this serum. It just works like straight up magic on my face and addresses so many things all at once with absolutely zero irritation at all. I have fair-light combination skin that, thanks to my irish ancestors, makes any blemish and any leftover healing spots a bright red glaringly obvious mark on my fair pinkish ubdertoned skin. They used to take FOREEEVER to fade. I mean months. Not anymore. I struggle with large stretched out pores from excess sebum production in certain areas of my tzone. Not anymore. Have problems with breakouts and blackheads in certain places that just seem to have frequent issues. Not anymore. I used to just have random redness from unknown irritant here and there. Not anymore. Super shiny tzone by afternoon. Not anymore. This stuff fixed it all for me. And it did it FAST. I'm talking noticeable effects in minutes. Even better an hour later. Still awesome hours later. Next day awesomeness. Consistent use cleared all my problems in a matter of days. I'm obsessed and I want to buy all bottles so no one else can have them so I'll never run out. I shouldn't be leaving this review and telling people about my magic serum. But I can't help it. I just have to sing it's praises because I need Cosrx to know I need a lifetime supply.

I liked this but I dont feel like the product is worth it for the small amount you get. 0.67oz. Not even a full ounce, so it is gone very quickly. The package itself is very bulky and heavy alluding to there being more product. I would be willing to pay for more product in a more environmentally friendly package.

I have almost used all of my first bottle of the COSRX Niacinamide and just ordered another bottle! I saw a difference in my skin within two days. My pores are smaller, and my sebaceous hyperplasia bumps are disappearing! It's not oily and quickly absorbs into my skin- making it great for my morning routine. I gave it 4 stars because the dropper is not able to suck out the last quarter or so of product. I've had to pour it on my hand to apply, which ends up wasting some as it's easy to pour too much. Also, the bottle is only .67 ounces compared to most serums being at least a full 1 ounce.

avis.titre: Stronger than hormonal acne, safe for sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is no longer oily and looks so healthy. Breakouts have totally cleared after just two weeks, just by adding this to my nighttime routine. My skin is so sensitive that I'm allergic to some fabrics, but this doesn't cause any redness or swelling. Highly recommend!
I have OCD and pick my skin. I have a lot of scarring and skin discoloration from past picks. This product is clearing up the scarring and evening skin tone.

I've only had it for about 2 weeks, but so far it hasn't done much for my skin, and feels like it has been causing more pimples rather than eliminating. I heard it might be skin purging, but I'm not so sure. Not very impressed

avis.titre: Good product, be careful of over applying
avis.texte: I have used this product for two weeks and apply it after a BHA. Over the past two weeks I have noticed my pores appear smaller. My only problem was that I think I put it on too frequently in the beginning and caused my skin to flare up and become red. Overall, if you are careful of your skin sensitivity this product will work well for you. I do notice a slight burning when I apply this product, but after my first flare up my skin has been quite happy with it.

I love this so much I even had tried other products from the same company and overall the Korean skincare that they offer is amazing and it has cleared up my skin. This product helped out a lot because I mix this with their all in one moisturizer and it helps a lot with glowing and healing scars and making sure that my pores aren't huge and even controlling the oil that I produce throughout the day in my face. I highly recommend it as you can see when I post this comment they are currently sold out !!

I got this during the 21 day Ulta sale and so glad I did. This feels hydrating, plumps the skin, and gives that "inner glow" from within. For reference, I use a tret compound everyday and that makes my skin dry. Using this serum has helped my skin apprear less dry, more youthful by plumping up some areas of my cheeks. It's not a miracle change, but its enough for me to see a small change. I am curious as to what can happen with continued use. ❤️ I will continue to buy the CosRx Niacinamide 15 serum whether it's on sale or not.
Absorbs well into skin and has inproved the loom and feel of my skin within days.

So many things irritate my atopic dermatitis but I was determined to find a serum that I could use that could help scruff off the gross scaley parts of my face. The first time I used this, it stung my scaley spots and I was scared. It thankfully subsided quickly and sunk into my skin pretty well. After about 10 seconds, it felt normal again. I also paired my scaley spots with petroleum jelly and the combination of the two was amazing! By morning, after my morning wash, I noticed a significant difference in my skin. No other product I've been using had done this. I'm amazed at how clear my skin has become. I've been using this for about a week now and I still feel really great about the niacinamide 15 product. It no longer stings after the first try. So glad I gave this a shot.
Love this feels great on my skin. Clean and natural . Makes my skin look great.

I've used this for the first time today and I love it. I applied this at 9 am today and it's 3:30 pm now. My skin is usually extremely greasy and shiny by this point in the day, but instead my skin feels soft, yet matte. I'm very impressed by this product and will continue to use.

Ive tried niancinamade from many different brands and this is my favorite. The addition of zinc to the formula calms inflammation and really helps with redness post face wash if you deal with that like me. I have oily combo skin and it also greatly reduces my sebum production throughout the day. I also find its very brightening. Get it!

avis.titre: If you're eyeing it, buy it!
avis.texte: Ive been eyeing this niacinamide serum for a while but was skeptical bc of all the positive reviews (they're true!) Im on two uses, and this product helped regulate my oil production throughout the day!! Dries down relatively fast and does not feel tacky.

I bought this product because I love niacinamide but I do not want to support The Ordinary anymore. This is an amazing product, I see results much quicker than I did with The Ordinary! I already have repurchased it. It also hasn't made me break out at all.
Recommended by a friend. Great price. Great product. Noticed a difference in my skin pretty quickly

I have repurchased this three times now. I love it. It is a slippery liquid, not quite oily, and absorbs quickly. I really see a difference in my pores and oiliness and have less blemishes when I use this.
I am astonished at how well it works on keeping sebum levels down throughout the course of a busy day on my very sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great niacinamide serum for uneven skin tone
avis.texte: I have struggled with hormonal acne that I started to treat with tretinoin and spironolactone. This serum really helps with the redness, acne scars, and overall uneven skin tone.
I have acne rosacea and this product really has helped my skin
It's a wonder, by reducing acne residue, it gives me a blend of smooth skin, you should also try it
Not too harsh on my face and a great addition to my skincare routine. This is actually my second purchase of this product. I use it once a day and the bottle lasted me about 4 months.

I'm been though a few of these serums on my 3rd bottle, I would wash my face use a toner and then use the Niacinamide serum and I have noticed the quality is very good it doesn't have any residue and have has noticed a reduction in lines and texture on the skin

I was scared of using this order because usually niacinamide serums feeel like fire on my sling but I think the measured the ingredients correctly as well as not having it flavor one skin tone to the other. So it when I apply the residue it moustirizes my sling although I still feel some burning like putting spirit on a wound

I really like this serum. I ordered a couple other products based on the quiz so I'm not quite sure what exactly is making my skin look nice or if it's a combination of all of it but my skin is definitely looking brighter and less dull!
So far this product is really great! I like how light weight it feels onto my skin. It also absorbs super fast!

At 53, I have some wrinkles and still struggle with enlarged pores and blackheads. After cleansing, I use CosRX's AHA/BHA toner, follwed by their snail mucin, this, and their vitamin C serum. Never thought I'd use that many products in the morning, but my skin looks better after less than 2 weeks and feels very soft.
Very high quality packaging and ingredients. Application is simple, just a dropper. The serum is slightly thicker than the hyaluronic serum, but disappears into the skin and works wonders.

I started to get hormonal acne out of the blue about a year ago. I'm never used a serum before and nothing was helping, so I thought I'm give this one a try since I heard great things about niacinamide. I still have some breakouts here and there, but this has helped immensely in calming down my skin and getting my acne under control!
It's great for the first time to use this product and I'm very happy to use it!

I love the COSRX skin care product line! My skin is on the drier side but still very sensitive. It's been very difficult to find products that keep my face moisturized without breaking out. So many things, even very expensive and quality products, have petrolatum and shea butter in them. Both of them cause breakouts for me. The Niaacinamide 15 is keeping my skin looking radiant. I have bought sever other products and my skin is moisturized and white heads are vanishing.

for so long i thought i had some allergy with niacinmide because the aprilskin one would do the opposite for me and it worsened my handful of pimples to a severe acne, but i switched to this one for giggles and lo and behold i went from severe acne to a clear face. plot twist of 2023
I love the texture of the Serum, I use in my daily routine of skincare. This have a really light weight.

I love niacinamide serums, I have mature skin, normal to oily (depends on the season) and this serum is excellent. My skin can get red and inflamed easily by the simplest products but my skin loved this. I use it daily and will continue to purchase. I recently had a reaction to the ordinarys products and I learned about Cosrx last month.

I have bumpy combo skin with fine lines and acne that pops up too often. This serum has done a 180 for my skin. It's so much smoother and exfoliated without being irritated, and I haven't seen new acne since I started using it. My pores have shrunk too and there is much less oil throughout the day.

I got this to combat acne scars, hyperpigmentation, and larger pores on my cheeks. After I started using it I have already noticed my skin feeling softer and more plump. I know that over time my scars will diminish and I'm really happy that this is formulated to work on sensitive skin, it is incredibly effective.
Every since my favorite YouTuber recommended this brand I've been in love. Such affordable quality products that work!

My skin pours oil but is also extremely dry? I was super worried that when I applied this, it would burn my dry skin and honestly make things worse. It truly felt almost soothing and soaked into my skin very nice without drying it out. Most serums are just not for my really sensitive acne prone skin, but this one I'm truly in love with. I use it during the day because I use my tretinoin prescription at night.

I received this product for free from influenster in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this more more than a month I have seen a drastic change in my nose which usually gets a lot of buildup. I've been using this in combination with the vitamin c serum and both have tremendously transformed my skin. I have no pimples and my skin is glowing, will repurchase this and keep as a staple.

I received the Cosrx Niacinamide 15 serum complementary from Influenster in order for my honest review . My husband liked the serum. It helped his face feel less oily without drying his skin out. It's light on his skin , not thick like most serums He has uses. It doesn't have a scent which is very nice. I also think the packaging makes it look much more expensive than it is. I would recommend this product to a male or female.

So to be honest I have only ever had a simple and basic skincare routine and haven't tried a ton of stuff to add to it so I had to do some research to find out how to use these but once I did I actually really liked it after a few weeks especially now that I'm not in my teens or early twenties anymore! I liked how it feels on my skin and didn't have any reactions to it. I have combo skin and visible pores so I'm always looking for something to help that and I was able to notice an improvement. Definitely recommend doing some research before incorporating it into your routine if you?셱e a newbie like me but I am enjoying it so far! I received this free from influenster to review!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review compliments of Influenster and Cosrx. And I'm so glad that I got a chance to try it out. I'm very big on skincare and want to do my best to help minimize breakouts. I wouldn't say I have too much trouble with acne, but I definitely have a couple breakouts every month along with some general congestion. But I believe this has been helping me in terms of oil control and exfoliation. It's been great for my combination skin.

I'm definitely buying this, I loved it. Thanks to pcos I have some scarring and texture from over waxing on the bottom of my face, chin and neck. This helped a lot with it, my skin felt and looked smoother. It stung a little this first two times I used it but no problems or irritation.

I received this product for free in exchange of my honest review. I have normal skin and I've been using this product for about a month and I love how it leaves my skin glowy. It has no scent nor leaves your fingers sticky. Super easy to apply.

I enjoyed using this product. I felt like it easily absorbed into my skin. This seemed to improve the appearance of my pores and I felt less oily. While the product is fantastic, I also really enjoyed the packaging because it's so chic and beautiful. Would recommend to control oil and reduce the look of pores.

avis.titre: Sure to Even Your Skin Tone!
avis.texte: I love the fall season! It is my favorite but I make sure to layer up in my face care ritual and add my beloved serums under my skin cream!! I tried The Cosrx Niacinamide 15 Serum first, each for a week during the summer. I loved the way that the first serum gave my face an even tone and look even though It is intended for those with acne. I found the product too thick to use during the summer but I am definitely looking forward to using them this fall and winter!! ?쏧 received these products for free from Influenster and Cosrx in exchange for@my honest review.??#complimentary #cosrxdermserum @Influenster @cosrx

Received from Cosrx and Influenster for my review. I did like this serum. No scent, absorbs well, gives my glased skin. Sometimes when my barrier compromised the serum is too strong for me, especially using together with vit C. But all alone I do love it.

Overall, this product is great! The bottle is super cute and easy to use. I wish the dropper was a little bit longer, as feel like once I am almost done with the product it would be harder to reach the bottom. I did have a little trouble with the dropper getting clogged but it was fixable!! My skin looks great and I did see a small difference in the size of my pores and the overall texture of my skin!!.

Disclaimer: I received this complementary product from Influenster and Cosrx in exchange for my honest review. Overall, this product is great! The bottle is super cute and easy to use. I wish the dropper was a little bit longer, as feel like once I am almost done with the product it would be harder to reach the bottom. I did have a little trouble with the dropper getting clogged but it was fixable!! My skin looks great and I did see a small difference in the size of my pores and the overall texture of my skin!!.

I received the Niacinamide 15 serum complimentary from COSRX &Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I really enjoy using this serum. It applies nicely and doesn't make my skin feel sticky. It also absorbs quickly and makes my skin feel hydrated. I have oily skin and did notice a difference in oil production. I've been using this serum along with the Vitamin C 23 serum by COSRX for the past month. Between these 2 serums I have noticed my dark spots lightening up a bit. I recommend this serum and I am looking to purchase another bottle soon.

I have combination skin and I like to use any products that will help with any oiliness I have. I was excited to use this product to see if there would be any results. I also have blackheads on my nose, so that was something else I wanted to see if it would work on. I would use this in the mornings and slowly saw my skin less oily. I still have blackheads, but hopefully it's less with time. I received this product for free from Influenster and COSRX.

I'm new to the entire COSRX line and this is one of the first products I've purchased. I have sensitive skin that tends to be dry and I've recently started noticing the texture of my skin is getting rough and more uneven. I'm looking for products to help moisturize and balance my skin. I use this product sparingly and only on my nose and around my forehead where I have the mist uneven texture. It has done an excellent job of helping get rid of the bumps I had/have in those areas and doesn't overly irritate my skin. Any redness it causes disappears within a few minutes.

After reading comments that product was received cloudy or with floaters I was concerned, however I can tell you that wasn't my experience! In fact I used this until the last drop! It went on quickly and smoothly, no scent and drying time wasn't long. If I exfoliate, even lightly, there is a tiny sting, but nothing I was concerned with, it made me think it was working. After four weeks of use, results weren't huge but my skin is more even overall and brighter. I liked the packaging. Influenster and Cosrx sent me this product complimentary for my honest review.

Feels like your typical serum when applying. I've been using it for a few weeks now and haven't really noticed a difference with my skin. Considering this, I don't really see the point in using it. I don't dislike it though.

I like the texture of this serum. I like that also contains alantoine which it gives the moisture feeling. I've been using this for more than a month and I like it, but I have seen really a lot of changes. I like that the packaging is simple.

When applying it feels like any typical serum, however I did use it for two months and did not see any drastic differences. I guess I would consider skin type and the climate of where you live before using it. I don't hate the product, but I don't love it either.
Love this serum, I use it everyday morning and night. My skins feels smooth and hydrated. Packaging really sophisticated.

I've been using this serum since August, and I love everything about it. The packaging is beautiful and sleek. It absorbs well into my combination skin to make it smoother with no irritation. It says it controls oil and pores as well. My pores definitely look smaller and there's maybe only a liiittle difference in my oil production. I'm starting to run low, but I should have to re-up after October.

So I used the product for about a month straight &tbh, I couldn't tell a difference in my skin. It felt like a potent product but I didn't notice anything. I do love the branding (very similar to The Ordinary) and it's a nice feeling bottle.

This is a great product that I'm highly recommend! I liked how it made my skin glow and how it opened up my pores. I will be using this product continuously, it is now part of my nightly skin care routine!
The product help me a lot with black heads . It opens my pores and make my skin feel really soft
This plus BHA blackhead power liquid have visibly reduced amount of blackheads I get around my T-zone.

I really liked this product. the sensation that it leaves on your skin when it is fresh is unique, it has a good price in the market, I loved the presentation, a product that I will continue to use and would definitely buy again

This serum feels really nice on the skin, it doesn't leave a sticky residue like some other serums I've tried. I don't struggle with bad acne but this does seem to keep the little pimples I occasionally get at bay.

I enjoyed this product quite a bit, it did improve the look of my pores. I used it before bed every other night. I did also really enjoy the look of the packaging, it looks clinical but still like something accessible to the every day human. I would recommend this product to my friends as family, as well as repurchasing this for myself.

I love being able to mix and match serums to find the right solution for my skin. Although I love how this applied, I have dry skin and am not sure I saw the results someone with combo or oily skin would see.

This serum was hydrating and I didn't feel like my skin dried out after using it. It did help with clearing any little blemish that I might've had on my face. To me I didn't really see a whole lot of differences other than that so I do not use it as much. I did receive this for free from influencer and COSRX for my honest review.

This niacinamide was okay, I didn't notice any results to write home about. Sticky on the skin. The niacinamide dew drops worked so much better than this serum. I didn't notice hydration or added bounce to the skin. I like the packaging and the mission behind the company.

This serum works wonders for my combination-to-oily skin, prone to acne, blackheads and clogged pores, which are generally pretty noticeable. The product has unscented clear essence-like formula. It's lightweight but not drying. On the contrary, it's very nourishing but not greasy. I use it overnight and as soon as after the first application, I have noticed it's positive effect on my skin. I had some really severe acne and it had calmed down by the morning. In a few days, it had almost disappeared. After using the serum for a month, I've noticed that my skin breaks out less often. It also doesn't become as shiny during the day as usual. The serum helped me get rid of the majority of clogged pores and avoid new ones too. Moreover, the pores look smaller and tighter, while the skin feels smooth and soft. And I don't see many blackheads, so my skin has become much cleared in general. I now can't imagine my skincare routine without it.

avis.titre: Para control ligero de cutis graso
avis.texte: I have oil skin and clogged pores, this serum helps me to control a little acne breakouts. The packaging is minimalist and cute, also like the concept to recycle the bottles
So far I love this product! It's a little on the thicker side but dries quickly!

I love cosrx so I was sure I would like the niacinamide serum. It comes with a nice dropper which helps avoid cross contamination. I have relatively clear skin but I do have uneven texture and get the occasional break out and I definitely think using this daily has helped with both. I've used creams with niacinamide before but I like the serum better!

I have never tried a COSRX product &didn't know what to expect, but I was happily surprised with the effects! I received the Niacinimide 15 serum for free from @influenster &@COSRX in exchange for my honest review. It's job is to 1) control oil, &2) minimize pores &sebum; and I really think it accomplished both tasks! There is a noticeable difference in the way my skin looks, my pores have shrunk, &I am not breaking out at all! The product also has no scent, which I prefer over other face serums that have weird smells!

I am just loving this serum. It gets absorbed into the skin very quickly and nicely. No strong scent. After using this product for a couple of weeks, my skin has been glowing. It keeps it hydrated throughout the day. A must have in your routine and I highly recommend.

Received for free courtesy of influenster and cosrx for my honest review. The packaging of the rx line is super simplistic and minimalistic, like the black/white look. This bottle was short and round. The Niacinamide 15 is a concentrated serum that has 15% Niacinamide. The serum is nice. Its almost like a jelly watery consistency. I used this for about a month and a half. Mostly just mornings, but probably about 2x at night a week. I really enjoyed how after application my skin felt really nice, smooth and supple. Very bouncy. But as for long term effects...I didn't see much of anything. I have normal/dry skin. Didn't see much improvement on any dry areas of my skin...I really just liked how my skin was after immediate application...and it held up for a good chunk of the day. Overall, it's nice. But probably wouldn't buy it.

I really wanted to love this product, but for someone like me who has sensitive skin, this wasn't as gentle of a serum as I would've liked it to be. I broke out after using it a few times, initially it did seem to shrink my pores.

I love Cosrx! I received this product complimentary from Influenster for my honest review and I must say I'm so happy I received it! It was my first time trying this Serum and I noticed a huge difference in how my skin feels and looks! I definitely recommend this product!

This serum is my new fave for keeping my skin clear by helping to clear out my pores and stop breakouts. I can also see a notable difference in the size/visibility of my pores. I love this serum in combination with a hydrating moisturizer to keep my skin from becoming oily. Hands down recommend!
I liked the serum but unfortunately I don't love it. I didn't see any results and I don't like the smell that it has. I received this product for free from Influenster and cosrx for testing purposes.

I really wanted to love this product but I didn't see that much of a change in my skin. I used it every day because my skin is not sensitive. I have combination skin and it did help my pores shrink right away but it wasn't a long term solution. I did like that there is a dropper for no contamination. I love products with a dropper. I received this profit to test from influenster and cosrx

I received these from Cosrx and Influenster to review, and a glad to have found another serum from this brand that I love. It applies so smoothly, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a residue. It keeps my oil in control all day, only the second product I've ever found that can. And when they're together it's perfection.

I like this product. I feel like it does jts jib. I use it on my t zones of my face because thoes are the areas that get pretty shiny. I use it on my nose as well since u get blackheads on there. I have combunation skin and i feel it works really well on ne. I am happy it doesnt have lingering smell like somlike spme skin care products.
